title: Dashboard actions
summary: Wire a filter, highlight, URL or parameter action between two sheets, pick Hover, Select or Menu, and see what a click does and what clearing the selection does.
intro: Two sheets sit on one dashboard: `Minutes by Genre` is the source, `Titles` the target. Choose an action type and its options, then act on a bar and watch the target. Try clearing the selection under each option, and switch between a filter and a highlight action to see which one keeps the other rows.

copy.sample: Sample data invented for this simulator, not the Driftlight dataset.
copy.menuPath: On a dashboard, select Dashboard > Actions, then Add Action and choose a type. Each action has a source and a target sheet and a Run action on setting.
copy.filter: Filter: other sheets are filtered to the selected members.
copy.highlight: Highlight: matching marks on other sheets are highlighted.
copy.url: Go to URL: a web page opens, with field values in the URL.
copy.parameter: Change Parameter: a parameter takes the mark's value.
copy.hover: Run action on Hover: the action runs when the viewer moves over a mark.
copy.select: Run action on Select: the action runs when the viewer selects a mark.
copy.menu: Run action on Menu: the action is a link in the tooltip.
copy.clearLeave: Leave the filter: when the selection is cleared, the target keeps its filter.
copy.clearAll: Show all values: when the selection is cleared, the target shows all values again.
copy.clearExclude: Exclude all values: when the selection is cleared, all values are excluded from the target.
copy.paramKeep: Keep current value: when the selection is cleared, the parameter keeps the value it has.
copy.paramSet: Set value to: when the selection is cleared, the parameter is set to the value you choose (here, All).
copy.urlNote: A URL action inserts field values in angle brackets, as in <Genre>. The field must be used in the view; Detail is enough.
copy.urlMissing: This field is not used in the source view, so its value can't be inserted and the link comes out without it. Put the field on Detail.
copy.filterVsHighlight: A filter action removes marks from the target sheets; a highlight action keeps all marks and dims the others.
copy.useAsFilter: The Use as Filter option in a sheet's upper corner is a one-click filter action from that sheet to the others. Hover, Menu and what happens on clear are set under Dashboard > Actions.
copy.showFilterNote: Show Filter puts a filter card on the dashboard. To make the card filter every sheet, open its menu, choose Apply to Worksheets > Selected worksheets, then click All on dashboard.
copy.try: Try it: act on a bar in Minutes by Genre the way Run action on says (hover it, select it, or open its menu), then clear the selection.
copy.effectIdle: Nothing is selected, so the action has not changed anything: the target shows all its rows with none dimmed.
copy.effectFilter: Filter action: Titles shows only {genre}. The other marks are removed from the target.
copy.effectFilterHeld: The selection is cleared, but the filter is left in place: Titles still shows only {genre}.
copy.effectFilterExcluded: The selection is cleared and all values are excluded: Titles shows no rows.
copy.effectHighlight: Highlight action: Titles keeps every row and highlights {genre}; the other rows are dimmed.
copy.effectUrl: Go to URL action: this is the link the action would open (this simulator does not open it).
copy.effectParam: Change Parameter action: the parameter now holds the mark's value, {genre}.
copy.effectParamHeld: The selection is cleared, and the parameter keeps its current value, {genre}.
